WITH payload AS (
  SELECT '{{$json.payload_sql}}'::jsonb AS body
), client_input AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(COALESCE(body->'client_profile'->>'client_code', body->>'client_code'), '') AS client_code,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(body->'client_profile'->>'client_name',''), NULLIF(body->>'client_name',''), NULLIF(COALESCE(body->'client_profile'->>'client_code', body->>'client_code'), ''), 'Default Client') AS client_name,
    NULLIF(COALESCE(body->'client_profile'->>'preferred_tone', body->>'preferred_tone'), '') AS preferred_tone,
    NULLIF(COALESCE(body->'client_profile'->>'industry', body->>'industry'), '') AS industry,
    NULLIF(COALESCE(body->'client_profile'->>'compliance_notes', body->>'compliance_notes'), '') AS compliance_notes,
    COALESCE(body->'client_profile'->'brand_voice', '{}'::jsonb) AS brand_voice,
    COALESCE(body->'client_profile'->'tone_rules', '[]'::jsonb) AS tone_rules,
    COALESCE(body->'client_profile'->'approved_claims', '[]'::jsonb) AS approved_claims,
    COALESCE(body->'client_profile'->'forbidden_claims', '[]'::jsonb) AS forbidden_claims,
    COALESCE(body->'client_profile'->'product_families', '[]'::jsonb) AS product_families,
    COALESCE(body->'client_profile'->'output_defaults', '{}'::jsonb) AS output_defaults,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(body->'client_profile'->>'default_approval_policy',''), NULLIF(body->>'default_approval_policy',''), 'full_staged') AS default_approval_policy,
    COALESCE(body->'client_profile'->'asset_roots', '[]'::jsonb) AS asset_roots,
    COALESCE(body->'client_profile'->'delivery_preferences', '{}'::jsonb) AS delivery_preferences
  FROM payload
), upsert_client AS (
  INSERT INTO client_profiles (client_code, client_name, preferred_tone, industry, compliance_notes, brand_voice, tone_rules, approved_claims, forbidden_claims, product_families, output_defaults, default_approval_policy, asset_roots, delivery_preferences)
  SELECT client_code, client_name, preferred_tone, industry, compliance_notes, brand_voice, tone_rules, approved_claims, forbidden_claims, product_families, output_defaults, default_approval_policy, asset_roots, delivery_preferences
  FROM client_input
  WHERE client_code IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (client_code) DO UPDATE SET
    client_name=EXCLUDED.client_name,
    preferred_tone=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.preferred_tone, client_profiles.preferred_tone),
    industry=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.industry, client_profiles.industry),
    compliance_notes=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.compliance_notes, client_profiles.compliance_notes),
    brand_voice=COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.brand_voice, '{}'::jsonb), client_profiles.brand_voice),
    tone_rules=COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.tone_rules, '[]'::jsonb), client_profiles.tone_rules),
    approved_claims=COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.approved_claims, '[]'::jsonb), client_profiles.approved_claims),
    forbidden_claims=COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.forbidden_claims, '[]'::jsonb), client_profiles.forbidden_claims),
    product_families=COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.product_families, '[]'::jsonb), client_profiles.product_families),
    output_defaults=COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.output_defaults, '{}'::jsonb), client_profiles.output_defaults),
    default_approval_policy=COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.default_approval_policy,''), client_profiles.default_approval_policy),
    asset_roots=COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.asset_roots, '[]'::jsonb), client_profiles.asset_roots),
    delivery_preferences=COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.delivery_preferences, '{}'::jsonb), client_profiles.delivery_preferences),
    updated_at=now()
  RETURNING *
), resolved_client AS (
  SELECT * FROM upsert_client
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cp.* FROM client_profiles cp, client_input ci
  WHERE ci.client_code IS NOT NULL AND cp.client_code=ci.client_code AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upsert_client)
  LIMIT 1
), upsert_job AS (
  INSERT INTO content_jobs (external_job_ref, client_profile_id, project_name, brief_text, requested_outputs, drive_root_folder_id, status, approval_policy, created_by)
  SELECT
    NULLIF(body->>'external_job_ref',''),
    (SELECT id FROM resolved_client),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(body->>'project_name',''),'Untitled AI content job'),
    COALESCE(body->>'brief_text',''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(body->'requested_outputs','[]'::jsonb), (SELECT output_defaults->'requested_outputs' FROM resolved_client), '[]'::jsonb),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(body->>'drive_folder_id',''), (SELECT asset_roots->>0 FROM resolved_client)),
    'intake_complete',
    COALESCE(NULLIF(body->>'approval_policy',''), (SELECT default_approval_policy FROM resolved_client), NULLIF(body->'client_profile'->>'default_approval_policy',''), 'full_staged'),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(body->>'created_by',''),'api_supervisor')
  FROM payload
  ON CONFLICT (external_job_ref) DO UPDATE SET
    updated_at=now(),
    status='intake_complete',
    brief_text=EXCLUDED.brief_text,
    client_profile_id=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.client_profile_id, content_jobs.client_profile_id),
    requested_outputs=EXCLUDED.requested_outputs,
    drive_root_folder_id=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.drive_root_folder_id, content_jobs.drive_root_folder_id),
    approval_policy=EXCLUDED.approval_policy
  RETURNING id, status, client_profile_id, requested_outputs, approval_policy
), msg AS (
  INSERT INTO job_messages (job_id, sender_type, sender_id, message_type, message_text, attachments)
  SELECT id, 'agent', COALESCE(NULLIF((SELECT body->>'sender_id' FROM payload),''),'supervisor'), 'brief', COALESCE((SELECT body->>'message' FROM payload),(SELECT body->>'brief_text' FROM payload),''), '[]'::jsonb FROM upsert_job RETURNING id
), event AS (
  INSERT INTO content_events (job_id, event_type, message, metadata)
  SELECT id, 'intake_complete', 'Job intake completed', jsonb_build_object('operator_architecture','v2','mode',(SELECT body->>'mode' FROM payload),'client_profile_id',(SELECT client_profile_id FROM upsert_job),'approval_policy',(SELECT approval_policy FROM upsert_job)) FROM upsert_job RETURNING id
)
SELECT id::text AS job_id,
       status::text AS status,
       approval_policy,
       COALESCE(client_profile_id::text,'') AS client_profile_id,
       requested_outputs::text AS requested_outputs_json,
       COALESCE((SELECT row_to_json(resolved_client)::jsonb FROM resolved_client)::text,'{}') AS client_profile_json
FROM upsert_job;
